name: JV_OWNER_PERCENTS_F_B
description: This table contains the date effective ownership percentage information for a joint venture.

columns.name: OWNERSHIP_PERCENTAGE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the ownership percentage.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: OWNERSHIP_PERCENT_SHORT_NAME
columns.description: The short name of the ownership percentage that is used as an identifier across effective dates for the joint venture.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_START_DATE
columns.description: Date Effective Entity: indicates the date at the beginning of the date range within which the row is effective.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
columns.description: Date Effective Entity: indicates the date at the end of the date range within which the row is effective.

columns.name: JOINT_VENTURE_ID
columns.description: The joint venture ID that the ownership percentage is associated with. It is defined in the JV_JOINT_VENTURES_B table.

columns.name: OWNERSHIP_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: The status code of the joint venture ownership percentage. It is based on the ORA_JV_OWNERSHIP_STATUS lookup codes like Active, Inactive, etc.

columns.name: OWNERSHIP_CHANGE_FLAG
columns.description: This will be set to true only when the ownership definition is associated with at least one joint venture transaction that has been distributed and needs to be reprocessed.

columns.name: CHANGE_REASON_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the reason for changing the effective dates on the ownership definition. It is based on ORA_JV_CHANGE_REASON_CODE lookup codes.

columns.name: CHANGE_REASON_ADDITIONAL_TEXT
columns.description: Additional information describing the reason for changing the effective dates on the ownership definition.

columns.name: STAKEHOLDER_GROUP_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the stakeholder group associated with a carried interest agreement.

columns.name: ORIGINAL_OWNERSHIP_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the original ownership definition used to create the carried interest ownership definition.

columns.name: OWNERSHIP_VERSION
columns.description: Version of the ownership definition. It increments when the carried interest ownership definition becomes permanently inactive.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
